biggest_catch: Commission rates are item-specific, not flat — Rebag tells you the exact rate per quote, and lower-value items pay steeper rates (most fall 15–25%).
catches: Commission as low as 8% on in-demand high-value pieces; most items fall in the 15–25% range; exact rate communicated per quoted item.
Buyout (instant cash) pays less than Consignment (waits for sale) — the speed premium comes out of your payout.
Trade credit earns up to 5% more, plus 1% bonus credit per month for up to 9 months (Premium Payouts).
Payment after the vetting process, up to ~3 days; no fees — Rebag builds costs into the quote.
Consignment items must sell; buyout is guaranteed cash once the quote is accepted and vetted.

maximize: Get quotes for all three paths — Consign vs Buyout vs Trade — because the instant cash of Buyout can be meaningfully less than Consignment on the same bag. If you're buying another luxury piece anyway, Trade adds up to 5% plus 1%/month premium credit (up to 9 months). Keep your item listed through Consignment to stack the premium payout bonus. In-demand brands (Hermès, Chanel, Louis Vuitton) earn the lowest commission (as low as 8%) — that's the inventory to route here rather than to The RealReal's steeper tiers. Always decline a quote you don't like; it's free to walk away.
